publicPage.headline: Joseph & Marie
publicPage.subheadline: A day of love, commitment, and celebration.
publicPage.mainMessage: We joyfully celebrate our union on Tuesday, December 1, 2026.
publicPage.personalLinkInstruction: To discover the details of your invitation and send us your response, please use the personal link that was sent to you.
publicPage.editorialTitle: A union, a promise, a new life.
publicPage.editorialP1: It is with immense joy that Joseph and Marie invite you to share one of the happiest days of their lives: the celebration of their wedding.
publicPage.editorialP2: Surrounded by their families, friends, and loved ones, they wish to experience this moment in an atmosphere of love, elegance, and warmth.
publicPage.editorialP3: Your presence will be a precious testimony of affection and support for them.
publicPage.privateAccessNoticeBody: This website uses personalized private invitations. Detailed schedules, exact addresses, and the RSVP form are displayed exclusively through the individual link sent by Joseph and Marie or their families.
publicPage.demoSectionSubtitle: Experience how the interface and API responses strictly adapt to the authorized events and seating rules for each guest:

invitation.seatsNoticeSingular: This invitation is reserved for 1 guest.
invitation.seatsNoticePlural: This invitation is reserved for {count} guests.
invitation.seatsByEventNotice: Seating tailored per event (up to {count} guest(s)).
